summary_reason: The input exhibits severe mechanical template substitution errors. 検収 was forced into an accounting entry/balance slot ('検収の残高', '検収の計上内容'), which is unnatural and accounting-inaccurate. Examples and dialogue must reflect authentic business practice (検収基準, 検収書, 動作テスト).

collocations.reason: Natural and standard workplace collocation for carrying out inspection and acceptance.
Common business expression signifying completion of inspection and acceptance.

collocations.text: 検収の手順を確認する
collocations.reason: Natural operational phrase used when reviewing procedures.
collocations.suggested_text: 検収の手順を確認する

collocations.reason: 検収 is an operational act or milestone. Native speakers review the criteria (検収基準) or procedure (検収フロー/プロセス), or issue documents (検収書を発行する), rather than '見直す' 検収 directly.

examples.reason: 検収 is an act/procedure (inspection and acceptance). It is not an accounting balance sheet item, so '検収の残高' is factually nonsensical in accounting. This is an artifact of a generic automated template.
examples.suggested_ja: 当社では検収基準を採用しているため、顧客から検収書を受領した日付で売上を計上します。
examples.suggested_vi: Vì công ty chúng tôi áp dụng tiêu chuẩn nghiệm thu, nên doanh thu sẽ được ghi nhận vào ngày nhận được biên bản nghiệm thu từ khách hàng.
examples.suggested_en: Since our company adopts the inspection and acceptance basis, we recognize revenue on the date we receive the acceptance certificate from the customer.

examples.reason: '決算において検収を適正に処理いたしました' is stilted and unnatural corporate template jargon. In actual business/procurement, acceptance triggers billing or accounts payable booking.
examples.suggested_ja: 納入物の検収が完了次第、取引先に検収書を交付し、仕入高の計上処理を行ってください。
examples.suggested_vi: Ngay sau khi hoàn thành nghiệm thu hàng bàn giao, hãy phát hành biên bản nghiệm thu cho đối tác và thực hiện xử lý hạch toán mua hàng.
examples.suggested_en: As soon as the inspection and acceptance of the delivered items is complete, please issue the acceptance certificate to the vendor and proceed with recording the purchase entry.

dialogue.reason: '検収の計上内容' is robotic template language. Business conversations regarding 検収 focus on whether physical inspection is finished, acceptance sign-offs received, or revenue/costs booked accordingly.

suggested_turns.speaker: A
suggested_turns.ja: 先週納品された基幹システムについて、現場での検収は完了していますか。
suggested_turns.vi: Hệ thống cốt lõi được bàn giao vào tuần trước đã hoàn tất nghiệm thu tại hiện trường chưa?
suggested_turns.en: Has the on-site inspection and acceptance been completed for the core system delivered last week?

suggested_turns.speaker: B
suggested_turns.ja: はい、動作テストも問題なく終了し、先ほど先方から検収書を受領いたしました。
suggested_turns.vi: Vâng, việc chạy thử nghiệm đã hoàn tất tốt đẹp và chúng tôi vừa nhận được biên bản nghiệm thu từ phía đối tác.
suggested_turns.en: Yes, operational testing was completed without issue, and we just received the acceptance certificate from the client.

translations.reason: The Vietnamese and English candidate translations suffered from copying the repetitive gloss 'nghiệm thu sản phẩm / kiểm tra bàn giao' verbatim into sentence contexts, and the English translated nonsensical accounting phrasing ('entries or balances for inspection and acceptance').
